answer: Successfully browsed the Civil Division Documents and Forms page at justice.gov/civil/documents-and-forms-0. The page displays five main document/form categories: Civil Division Enforcement Priorities, Commercial Litigation Documents & Forms, Enforcement & Affirmative Litigation Branch Documents & Forms, Office of Immigration Litigation Documents & Forms, and Torts Branch Documents & Forms. Additionally, the page includes information about Standard Form 95 for Federal Tort Claims Act claims. The page was last updated July 10, 2026.
